biggest_catch: Everything hinges on crossing 1,000 kWh each cycle — fall short and you pay the full rate with no credit.
catches: $9.95/month base charge plus energy charges apply regardless of the credit.
Credit is savings on planned energy spending, not cash.

c1.evidence: Provider's own EFL (residential.txu.com, dated 2026-08-08) loaded and states the $100 bill credit terms.

c2.evidence: Concrete amounts on the provider's own disclosure: $100.00 bill credit at >=1,000 kWh, plus $25.00 summer credit.

c3.evidence: No enrollment fee; the plan is normal energy service with usage-gated bill credits.

c4.evidence: EFL dated 2026-08-08, current as of the 2026-09-23 check.

eligibility: Texas residential customers enrolling on the TXU Energy Smart 1000 Select 12 plan.
notes: Bill credits framed as savings on planned energy spending, not income. Distinct from R0845 TXU refer-a-friend (different mechanism).
numeric_basis: payout from official EFL ($100 flat, +$25 summer); time: online enrollment est. 20-30 min active
payout_quote: A bill credit of $100.00 will be applied for each billing cycle in which usage is 1000 kWh or more. A $25.00 summer bill credit will be applied for each billing cycle ending in July, August, and September in which usage is 1000 kWh or more.
payout_value_note: $100/month bill credit when usage >=1,000 kWh; extra $25 summer credit for billing cycles ending July, August, and September (also >=1,000 kWh).

s1.note: Texas residential customers on the Smart 1000 Select 12 plan, per the provider's own EFL.

s2.note: No signup fee; $150 early cancellation fee disclosed.

s3.note: Credits apply automatically each qualifying billing cycle.

s4.note: Payout stated exactly with no weasel words.

s6.note: Steps are concrete: enroll, use >=1,000 kWh, credit applies automatically.

steps: Enroll on TXU Energy Smart 1000 Select 12.
Use 1,000 kWh or more in a billing cycle.
The $100 credit (plus $25 for billing cycles ending in July, August, or September) applies automatically to that cycle's bill.
timing: Enrollment ~20 minutes online; credits apply automatically each qualifying billing cycle.
